newsitem.title: USA: Zydeco Energy pacts with Grant Geophysical.
newsitem.headline: Zydeco Energy pacts with Grant Geophysical.

text.p: Zydeco Energy Inc on Wednesday said it signed a geophysical contract with Grant Geophysical Inc to continue its survey operations over Zydeco's seismic project in Louisiana.
The current contract requires Zydeco to pay Grant its costs plus a fixed percentage for its services with an incentive bonus for early completion.
Zydeco expects survey operations in western Cameron parish to begin immediately and recording operations to begin in mid-April and to conclude this summer.
The operation had been suspended in early December due to weather conditions, Zydeco said.
